traffic.mp4.description: Predefined demonstrator calibration for videos/traffic.mp4 (720x1280). Approximates a 10m wide by 35m long road perspective quadrilateral on the lower camera road plane. Not for certified legal enforcement.

traffic_2min.mp4.description: 4-point planar perspective homography calibration for 1080p highway video (traffic_2min.mp4). Mapped to 12.0m 3-lane width by 30.0m roadway plane.

custom_camera_template.description: Template schema for custom camera installations. Replace with 4 surveyed ground-plane landmarks (e.g. lane markings, stop lines) and measured distances in meters.
